hypothesis: Geothermal systems are commonly hosted on blind or partially-mapped faults absent from the USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue.  The nine prior GEMSDOE submissions form one family on the catalogue corridor (pairwise 86-100% forward 3-px overlap; |Spearman| 0.52-1.00), so the complementary, uncatalogued fault set lies outside their 3-px halos.  Dots restricted to novel territory target that missing fault set and are unique by construction.
mechanism: DTI = TP / (TP + 0.2 FP + 0.8 FN) with a 300 m triangular kernel.  Catalogue faults are masked from scored truth, so dots on the catalogue corridor earn little TP and real FP; novel-territory dots target uncatalogued structures.  Binary dots concentrate probability (TP linear in p, FP weighted only 0.2).  Pixels are ranked by distance to the nearest prior dot (farther = less redundant).
named_non_fault_mimic: Pluvial Lake Lahontan shoreline berms, TIGER road/rail embankments, and conductive playas can produce linear anomalies in novel territory; mitigated by restricting dots to novel territory and a sparse count.
